title: Engineers Rolled a 4,830-Ton Lighthouse More Than Half a Mile

scenes.text: In 1999, engineers picked up a lighthouse and moved it.
It weighs forty eight hundred and thirty tons, and it's the tallest brick lighthouse in the United States.
The sea had crept to just one hundred twenty feet away. It was built fifteen hundred feet back.
They lifted it with hydraulic jacks and rolled it on steel tracks, five feet at a time.
It travelled twenty nine hundred feet in twenty three days.
Today it stands sixteen hundred feet from the sea, still shining.

description:
In 1999, engineers moved the 4,830 ton Cape Hatteras Lighthouse 2,900 feet to save it from the sea.
They lifted it with hydraulic jacks and rolled it on steel tracks, five feet at a time, in 23 days.
What is the biggest thing you have ever seen moved? Comment below.
first_comment: They moved 4,830 tons by hydraulic jack. What building would you want to see moved?
